tradify.intro: Tradify is a popular job management tool, but its per-user pricing gets expensive fast. Paying another $48 a month just to add an apprentice to the system doesn't sit right with a lot of tradies. If you're looking for an alternative, you're in the right spot. This guide compares the best options for Australian trades. For sole traders and small crews who need fast, accurate quoting with live supplier prices, QuoteMate is our top pick. But other tools like ServiceM8 or Fergus might be a better fit depending on your trade and team size.

sections.heading: Why QuoteMate is the best Tradify alternative
sections.body: Tradify is a decent all-rounder for scheduling and invoicing, but its quoting is manual. QuoteMate is built to fix that. Its AI suggests materials and labour for your job, then pulls live Australian supplier prices. This stops you from underquoting using last month's prices. The biggest difference is the cost. Tradify charges per user, so a three-person team costs over $140 a month. QuoteMate is a flat $49 a month for your whole team. It also has a proper free plan to start with, and lets you take payment on site with Square.

sections.heading: How to choose the right Tradify alternative
sections.body: If you need more than just quoting, other tools have their strengths. ServiceM8 is built for Apple users and is strong on job cards, forms, and scheduling, but its pricing is based on the number of jobs you do. Fergus is popular with plumbers and sparkies because it focuses heavily on detailed job costing and profit tracking. For larger, more established businesses, AroFlo and simPRO offer deep features for compliance, inventory, and supplier management. Both are powerful but come with higher per-user costs and setup fees, making them overkill for smaller crews who just need to get quotes out the door.

faqs.question: Is there a free alternative to Tradify?
faqs.answer: Yes. QuoteMate offers a proper free plan that's perfect for sole traders getting started. Tradify has no free option, only a trial. ServiceM8 also has a free plan, but it’s limited to a small number of jobs per month. For a genuine free tool to run your quoting, QuoteMate is the best starting point.

faqs.question: Can I move my customer and job data from Tradify?
faqs.answer: Most apps, including QuoteMate, let you import your customer list from a CSV file, which you can export from Tradify. This gets your client details across easily. Moving detailed job histories or invoices is usually a more manual process, so it's best to check the import guides for the specific software you're switching to.

faqs.question: What is the cheapest Tradify alternative for a small crew?
faqs.answer: For a team, QuoteMate's flat-fee Pro plan is the cheapest at $49/month for everyone. Tradify, Fergus, and AroFlo charge per user, so a three-person team costs $140+ per month. QuoteMate's model saves you over a thousand dollars a year as soon as you put on your first apprentice, without sacrificing powerful quoting features.
